name: DREAMTECH Co., Ltd.
summary: DREAMTECH Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of modules in South Korea and internationally. It offers various PBA modules for smartphones and wearables; fingerprint sensor modules for biometric, convergence solutions, and medical systems; optical sensors for office appliances; and compact camera modules for IT devices and automotive applications. The company also engages in manufacturing various IT devices and components, such as smartphones, wireless earphones, laptops, etc. Its products are used in smartphones, fingerprint recognition, medical/healthcare devices, and convergence applications. DREAMTECH Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Seongna…
